# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P73](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0073)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Phillips glares sternly when discipline is broken in his classroom.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)_

## Personality

Mr. Phillips carries out his discipline with a high hand, occasionally punishing unfairly or enforcing embarrassing rules such as making female students sit with boys. While not considered an exceptionally good teacher, pupils who are determined to learn can still make progress under him. He shows favoritism and spends time during class giving individual attention to older students like Prissy Andrews.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)_

## Traits

- Stern  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- Strict  <sub>[v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching elementary and advanced school subjects  <sub>[v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster at Avonlea School. During his tenure, he spent classroom time in the back of the room assisting older pupils like Prissy Andrews with advanced subjects such as Latin and algebra. He maintained order through stern reprimands, once causing Ruby Gillis to cry with his glare after a disruption secretly caused by Gilbert Blythe. After Anne Shirley was late for school, he singled her out for punishment by making her sit with Gilbert Blythe, leading Anne to feel insulted and refuse to attend school for a period. Despite his teaching shortcomings, dedicated students made academic progress in his class, with Anne and Gilbert being promoted to the fifth class under his instruction to study Latin, geometry, French, and algebra. He noted that Anne was particularly struggling with geometry, calling her a dunce at the subject.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P73](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0073), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038)_
